claims.claim: KMeans minimizes within-cluster sum of squared distances to assigned centroids and can converge to local minima.
claims.notes: Inertia decreases with more clusters and is not a universal cluster-count criterion.

claims.claim: DBSCAN identifies density-connected regions using eps neighborhoods and min_samples core-point conditions.
claims.notes: min_samples includes the point itself; scale and density variation matter.

claims.claim: Silhouette compares within-cluster cohesion with nearest alternative-cluster separation for labeled cluster assignments.
claims.notes: It is undefined for degenerate labelings and can favor particular geometric structures.

claims.claim: Internal clustering scores do not establish that clusters are meaningful business segments or causal groups.
claims.notes: Human interpretation, stability and downstream validation are still required.
